assets.name: panel-parchment
assets.prompt: Edit/extraction target reference welcome UI. Recreate/extract ONLY the large cream parchment panel with thick stepped ivory inner border, honey WOOD outer rim and ornate GOLD CORNER BRACKETS at all FOUR corners. Match the reference exactly in colors and thickness. Remove ALL content from inside: title sign, all text, Vanessa and dog, book, leaves, button, icons, divider. Interior must be uniformly warm cream #fff5df with a very subtle paper texture, blank. Outside the rectangular frame genuinely transparent, no map/background. Rectangular panel aspect ratio 1.47:1, large border width about 24px at a panel width 1040px, chunky pixel-art edging particularly corners. Output single isolated full panel frame blank with opaque cream center, NO text. Front view pixel art, no perspective. Reuse exact reference frame design, do not invent a thin modern gold outline. Intended to be nine-sliced.
